newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JIHD unit says secures $232.7 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: JIHD unit says secures $232.7 mln loan.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Arthayasa Grahatama, a unit of PT Dhanayasa Arthatama which is a subsidiary of PT Jakarta International Hotels and Development (JIHD), said on Monday it had secured a $232.7 million syndicated loan from 15 banks.
Recent news reports said Dhanayasa Arthatama was expected to list its shares on the Jakarta stock exchange later this year.
Arthayasa said in a statement the proceeds would be used to finance the development of the International Conrad Centre.

The property project consists of Conrad International Hotel, Conrad International Residence, and shopping complex Conrad International Plaza located in Jakarta's central business district of Jalan Sudirman, it said.
The statement did not give further details, but said it planned to hold the loan signing ceremony and a news conference regarding the loan on Tuesday.
